=======================================

- Workflow: installer-image (disk install, image build, VM test)
- Commit: ${{ github.sha }}
- Branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
- Author: ${{ github.actor }}
- Commit Message: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
- Build URL: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}

Expected Duration: ~10-15 minutes total

Jobs (sequential):
1. disk-install (~3 min): Hands-off install onto loop device, 22 property checks
2. image (~30 s with cache, ~3 min cold): Assembles bootable UEFI ISO from cached base
3. vm-test (~4 min): QEMU/KVM install from ISO, UEFI boot, first-boot preflight + network
4. release (tags only): Publishes ISO as GitHub release with SHA256

This workflow runs on every push to main and usb-installer branch, and on version tags (v*).
Installed MacServers only update to commits where BOTH this workflow AND ci have passed.
